category: Mass layoff at the funded site
why_none: This one is a real gap rather than a threshold. A permanent cut of about 150 at one Archbold plant would normally require a notice, and none exists for Sauder in any published year, by name or by Fulton County. The state's record is dense in that window, including notices for 1 person and for 39 part-time workers, so it is unlikely to be an omission. The likeliest reading is that the layoff was expected to last under six months, which Ohio exempts, and which fits the plant staying open. The 150 figure therefore rests on press reporting alone.
